6 goals | player_label = | award = | prev_season = [[2024 U.S. Open Cup|2024]] | next_season = [[2026 U.S. Open Cup|2026]] }} The '''2025 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup''' was the 110th edition of the [[U.S. Open Cup]], the knockout [[domestic cup]] competition of [[Soccer in the United States|American soccer]], organized by the [[United States Soccer Federation]]. It involved 96 teams, including 64 teams from all three professional tiers of the [[United States soccer league system]], and 32 amateur teams in the "Open Division". The competition began on March 18 and culminated in the [[2025 U.S. Open Cup final|final]] on October 1. The [[2024 U.S. Open Cup|defending champions]], [[Los Angeles FC]], were represented by their reserve team, and were eliminated in the second round by extension side [[AV Alta]] of [[USL League One]].{{cite press release |date=January 28, 2025 |title=2025 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup Pits 32 Amateur Teams Against 32 Pros in First Round; Format and 96-Team Field Finalized |url=https://www.ussoccer.com/stories/2025/01/format-and-96-team-field-finalized-for-2025-lamar-hunt-us-open-cup |publisher=U.S. Soccer |accessdate=January 28, 2025}} The full format was announced on January 28, 2025. U.S. Soccer adopted new rules for the competition that restricted the use of alternative venues, and had random draws for hosting beginning in the Round of 16.{{cite news |last=Sillick |first=Jake |date=January 28, 2025 |title=2025 US Open Cup format revealed: More MLS teams return to competition |url=https://thecup.us/2025/01/28/2025-us-open-cup-format-revealed-more-mls-teams-return-to-competition/ |work=TheCup.us |accessdate=January 28, 2025}} Of the 27 American clubs in [[Major League Soccer]], 24 participated, with teams that were playing in the [[2025 CONCACAF Champions Cup]] being represented by their reserve teams.{{cite news |last=Tannenwald |first=Jonathan |date=January 28, 2025 |title=MLS and U.S. Soccer make progress toward peace over the U.S. Open Cup |url=https://www.inquirer.com/soccer/us-open-cup-major-league-soccer-nelson-rodriguez-20250128.html |work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]] |url-access=subscription |accessdate=January 28, 2025}} The first teams entered in the round of 32 (the fourth round), while the eight affiliated reserve teams and the two independent teams from [[MLS Next Pro]] participated beginning in the first round.{{cite news |last=Hernandez |first=Cesar |date=January 28, 2025 |title=MLS doubles first-team presence in U.S. Open Cup to 16 clubs |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/43518330/mls-sets-new-cup-qualification-standards-clubs |publisher=ESPN |accessdate=January 28, 2025}} [[Atlanta United FC]], [[Colorado Rapids]], and expansion [[San Diego FC]] did not have any representation from their clubs in the 2025 U.S. Open Cup.{{cite news |last=Woitalla |first=Mike |date=January 29, 2025 |title=U.S. Open Cup: MLS participation doubles to 16 clubs |url=https://www.socceramerica.com/u-s-open-cup-mls-participation-doubles-to-16-clubs/ |work=[[Soccer America]] |url-access=subscription |accessdate=January 30, 2025}}{{cite news |date=January 28, 2025 |title=North American cups: Where MLS teams will compete in 2025, qualification criteria |url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/mls-teams-cups-qualify-criteria-concacaf-leagues-us-canadian-2025-season |work=MLSsoccer.com |accessdate=January 28, 2025}} Half of the MLS first team entrants hosted their first matches, while the rest began with an away game. The MLS Next Pro teams were able to field players from their senior MLS team's supplemental roster via [[loan (association football)|loans]]. The [[USL Championship]] sent all 24 of its teams, with the highest sixteen rated teams of the 2024 regular season entering in the Third Round, and the eight lower-seeded teams entering in the first round alongside all 14 teams from [[USL League One]]. The 32 Open Division teams entered in the first round.
